CLINICAL INDICATION:
Assessment of the lower right third molar in a fictional patient with intermittent discomfort.

TECHNIQUE:
Synthetic panoramic dental radiograph text scenario. No image was acquired or analyzed by this application.

COMPARISON:
No earlier synthetic examination is available for this baseline record.

FINDINGS:
Lower right third molar is horizontally impacted. No evidence of a fracture. Correlate with clinical examination. The impacted tooth is in contact with the distal aspect of the lower right second molar. The visible mandibular cortex is continuous. The relationship to the inferior alveolar canal cannot be determined confidently on this panoramic examination.

IMPRESSION:
Horizontally impacted lower right third molar. Canal proximity remains indeterminate on the panoramic view.

CLINICAL CORRELATION:
Review the clinical symptoms and adjacent second molar. Any additional imaging decision requires clinician assessment.

LIMITATIONS:
Fictional report for software evaluation only. It is not a diagnostic interpretation of an actual image. Only the described findings are supported; unmentioned findings are unknown.
